title: Союзы контраста: although, even though, despite, in spite of, however, whereas

why: Эти слова показывают контраст или уступку: "хотя", "несмотря на", "однако", "тогда как". В русском мы их легко меняем местами, а в английском каждое слово требует после себя определённую конструкцию: предложение, существительное или -ing. Именно здесь русскоязычные чаще всего ошибаются.
formation: • although / though / even though + подлежащее + глагол: Although it was late, we kept working.
• despite / in spite of + существительное или V-ing: Despite the rain, ... / In spite of being tired, ...
• despite / in spite of + the fact that + предложение: Despite the fact that he was late, ...
• however, + предложение (отдельное предложение или после точки с запятой): It was cheap. However, it was poor quality.
• whereas / while + предложение (сравнение двух вещей): Tom is tall, whereas his brother is short.
usage: 1. Although / though / even though: неожиданный контраст. Even though сильнее, чем although. (Хотя шёл дождь, мы пошли гулять. — Although it was raining, we went for a walk.)
2. Despite / in spite of: то же значение, но дальше идёт существительное или -ing, а не целое предложение. (Несмотря на усталость, он закончил бег. — Despite being tired, he finished the run.)
3. However: связывает два отдельных предложения, после него запятая. (Предложение было хорошим. Однако я отказался. — It was a good offer. However, I turned it down.)
4. Whereas / while: противопоставление двух фактов. (Мой брат любит чай, а я люблю кофе. — My brother likes tea, whereas I like coffee.)
5. Though в конце фразы в разговорной речи: It's a nice car. Expensive, though. (Хотя дорогая.)
signalWords: "Хотя" + глагол → although; "несмотря на" + существительное → despite; "однако" между двумя предложениями → however; "а" при сравнении → whereas.
mistakes: ✗ Although he was tired, but he worked → ✓ Although he was tired, he worked (but не нужен)
✗ Despite of the rain → ✓ Despite the rain / In spite of the rain (of только в in spite of)
✗ Despite he was late → ✓ Despite being late / Although he was late (после despite нет подлежащего с глаголом)
✗ It was cold, however we went out → ✓ It was cold. However, we went out (however не соединяет предложения запятой)
✗ In spite the weather → ✓ In spite of the weather (of обязательно)
remember: Although + предложение, despite + существительное или -ing, however — всегда с запятой после него; и никакого "but" после although.

items.prompt: (a) Although (b) Despite it was late, we kept working.
items.answer: (a) Although

items.prompt: (a) Although (b) Despite the traffic, we arrived on time.
items.answer: (b) Despite

items.prompt: He passed the test (a) although (b) despite not studying much.
items.answer: (b) despite

items.prompt: (a) Even though (b) In spite of she is rich, she lives simply.
items.answer: (a) Even though

items.prompt: I fell asleep (a) although (b) despite the noise.
items.answer: (b) despite

items.prompt: (a) Though (b) In spite of the bad reviews, the movie made a lot of money.
items.answer: (b) In spite of

items.prompt: She went to work (a) even though (b) despite she had a fever.
items.answer: (a) even though

items.prompt: Despite ___ tired, he finished the run. (a) he was (b) being
items.answer: (b) being

exercises.instruction: Вставьте although, despite, in spite of, however или whereas

items.prompt: It was a good offer. ___, I turned it down.
items.answer: However

items.prompt: ___ the app is free, it has no ads.
items.answer: Although / Though / Even though

items.prompt: My sister loves sports, ___ I prefer reading.
items.answer: whereas / while

items.prompt: We stayed at the beach ___ the rain.
items.answer: despite / in spite of

items.prompt: ___ he works hard, he earns very little.
items.answer: Although / Though / Even though

items.prompt: She smiled ___ feeling nervous.
items.answer: despite / in spite of

items.prompt: Python is easy to learn, ___ C++ is much harder.
items.answer: whereas / while

items.prompt: ___ the fact that he was late, the boss stayed calm.
items.answer: Despite / In spite of

exercises.instruction: Соедините предложения, используя слово в скобках

items.prompt: It was raining. We went for a walk. (although)
items.answer: Although it was raining, we went for a walk. / We went for a walk although it was raining.

items.prompt: She was ill. She went to work. (despite)
items.answer: Despite being ill, she went to work. / Despite her illness, she went to work.

items.prompt: The car is old. It runs well. (even though)
items.answer: Even though the car is old, it runs well. / The car runs well even though it is old.

items.prompt: He studied a lot. He failed the exam. (in spite of)
items.answer: In spite of studying a lot, he failed the exam. / He failed the exam in spite of studying a lot.

items.prompt: Tom is very tall. His brother is short. (whereas)
items.answer: Tom is very tall, whereas his brother is short.

items.prompt: The hotel was cheap. It was very clean. (however)
items.answer: The hotel was cheap. However, it was very clean.

items.prompt: I was tired. I couldn't sleep. (despite the fact that)
items.answer: Despite the fact that I was tired, I couldn't sleep. / I couldn't sleep despite the fact that I was tired.

items.prompt: The movie was long. I enjoyed it. (although)
items.answer: Although the movie was long, I enjoyed it. / I enjoyed the movie although it was long.

exercises.instruction: Найдите ошибку и перепишите предложение правильно

items.prompt: Although he was tired, but he kept working.
items.answer: Although he was tired, he kept working.

items.prompt: Despite of the rain, we played football.
items.answer: Despite the rain, we played football. / In spite of the rain, we played football.

items.prompt: Despite he was late, nobody was angry.
items.answer: Although he was late, nobody was angry. / Despite being late, nobody was angry.

items.prompt: It was cold, however we went swimming.
items.answer: It was cold. However, we went swimming. / It was cold; however, we went swimming.

items.prompt: In spite the weather, the flight was on time.
items.answer: In spite of the weather, the flight was on time.

items.prompt: Despite the salary is high, the job is boring.
items.answer: Although the salary is high, the job is boring. / Despite the high salary, the job is boring.

items.prompt: I like him despite he is rude.
items.answer: I like him although he is rude. / I like him despite the fact that he is rude. / I like him despite his being rude.

items.prompt: I like tea, however my wife prefers coffee.
items.answer: I like tea, whereas my wife prefers coffee. / I like tea. However, my wife prefers coffee.

items.prompt: Хотя шёл дождь, мы пошли гулять.
items.answer: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.

items.prompt: Несмотря на усталость, он закончил проект.
items.answer: Despite being tired, he finished the project. / In spite of being tired, he finished the project.

items.prompt: Он много работает, однако зарабатывает мало.
items.answer: He works a lot. However, he earns very little. / He works a lot; however, he earns very little.

items.prompt: Мой брат любит город, а я люблю деревню.
items.answer: My brother likes the city, whereas I like the countryside.

items.prompt: Хотя я плохо спал, я чувствую себя хорошо.
items.answer: Even though I slept badly, I feel fine. / Although I slept badly, I feel fine.

items.prompt: Несмотря на пробки, мы приехали вовремя.
items.answer: Despite the traffic, we arrived on time. / In spite of the traffic, we arrived on time.

items.prompt: Несмотря на то что у него нет опыта, его взяли на работу.
items.answer: Despite the fact that he has no experience, he got the job. / In spite of the fact that he has no experience, he was hired.

items.prompt: Приложение дорогое. Однако оно того стоит.
items.answer: The app is expensive. However, it is worth it.
